public_holidays: 26 May 2026: non-working day for the anniversary of Ilo Province, not automatically all Moquegua. 14 October: non-working holiday for Santa Fortunata.
25 November 2026: non-working day for the anniversary of Moquegua, explicitly Mariscal Nieto scope. Not a province-wide assumption for Ilo or General Sánchez Cerro.
